questions.subject: Lena Ortiz (AC-E04)
questions.text: route-log.csv shows Lena Ortiz (AC-E04) on a delivery vehicle on 60 days in the period, in 31 weeks, up to 3 days in one week. We moved 9123.50 of this pay to T-610 (CG-31) on that basis. The application says: "Our dispatchers work the phones. Lena rides along about two days a week to train new stops, so at most two fifths of her time is on the road." Please confirm those days and how many days a week Lena Ortiz works; if fewer than the operating days in route-log.csv, the T-610 share rises. The application reported this pay under C-110.

questions.text: Please confirm that weekly-payroll.csv (weekly gross pay, used to price each route day) is complete for the audit period.

assumptions: Route-log division: a day on a delivery vehicle counts as a full day of T-610 work, and the days an employee works in a week are taken as the operating days in route-log.csv for that week (the records hold no attendance for office staff).
Principal business (CG-02): taken as the code with the most payroll outside C-110, measured from the records.
